liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Im In The Mood To Move**: back after 76 archived shows (2961 days) [8]
- **Pumpin For The Man**: back after 59 archived shows (2546 days); rare: 10 archived performances [8]
- **Push The Lil Daisies Up**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Play It Off Legit**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 7 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **Ween2016-08-25** (recommended): source not stated; 26 songs; 127 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **wn2016-08-25.Gefell_NBob_Aerco**: source not stated; 26 songs; 125 min [2]
- **ween2016-08-25.schoeps_mk21**: source not stated; 26 songs; 127 min [3]
- **ween2016-08-25.mk4_24bit**: source not stated; 26 songs; 126 min [4]

## Around the show

- Umphrey's McGee opened the bill before Ween took the stage [1]
- Gener joined Ween near the set's end to perform The Stranger [1]
- Gener joined the band late in the set for a Billy Joel cover [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **Ween2016-08-25**: taped by Chris King [1]
- **wn2016-08-25.Gefell_NBob_Aerco**: taped by hypnocracy; transferred by hypnocracy; source: Gefell M20 > NBob Collettes > Naiant PFA > Aeroco MP-2 NOS @SNB Ridge Side > Tascam DR680 [2]. Also: Recorded on Tascam DR680, processed in Audacity, then CDWave and TLH [2]
- **ween2016-08-25.schoeps_mk21**: taped by Chris King; source: Schoeps mk21(nos)>Kcy>Schoeps Vst 62IUg>(Internal Pre)Sonosax SX-R4+ 24/96 [3]
- **ween2016-08-25.mk4_24bit**: taped by tonedeaf; transferred by tonedeaf; source: Schoeps mk4 > Nbob KCY Cables > Naiant PFA > PSP2 > Zoom F8 [4]
